description: EC2 Instance With Public IP and Unrestricted Inbound HTTPS (Potential ALB/WAF Bypass)
rationale: An instance network interface has a public IPv4 or globally routable IPv6 address and an attached security group permits TCP/443 from 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0. This is a direct-exposure candidate: security group rules alone cannot prove effective Internet reachability, as routes, NACLs, host firewall and listeners were not tested. A public application instance may bypass controls on a separate ALB or CDN.
remediation: Remove unnecessary public addresses and restrict inbound access to the load balancer security group or approved private network. Verify routing, NACLs, host firewall, and actual listener reachability independently.
